Dermatology clinic in Singapore

Specialist skin care for every age.

Medical, paediatric, surgical and cosmetic dermatology for children and adults, with clinics in Orchard and Farrer Park.

Care & services

Find care for your skin concern

Explore the clinic’s services, from childhood eczema and adult acne to mole checks and skin procedures.

  • Medical dermatology

    Adult acne, eczema, psoriasis, rashes and other skin conditions.

    Medical skin care ↗

  • Paediatric dermatology

    Care for newborn rashes, childhood eczema and birthmarks.

    Children’s skin care ↗

  • Skin procedures & surgery

    Minor procedures, skin growth removal and skin surgery.

    Skin procedures ↗

  • Cosmetic dermatology

    Consultations for acne scars, pigmentation and uneven skin tone.

    Cosmetic skin care ↗

  • Moles & skin screening

    Assessment of moles and screening for skin cancer.

    Mole checks ↗

  • Allergy testing

    Assessment of suspected allergies and discussion of testing options.

    Allergy services ↗

Does the clinic see children?

Yes. Paediatric dermatology includes consultations for newborn rashes, childhood eczema and birthmarks.

Where can I check insurance panels?

The clinic lists its insurance panels and partners on its contact page. Check your plan with your insurer before your visit.
